primitives.name: Pose Descriptor Encoding
primitives.verbatim_quote: Modalities computed per clip: RGB cuboids (120×120×100 ≈ 0.83 s), optical flow (iterative re-weighted least squares, foreground-masked, μ+3σ normalized), pose (PoseNet/PersonLab, 13 joints + pose center → 14×(x,y,score) descriptor; 25% of frames have no detection — filled with ROI center + score 0).
primitives.assumptions: Keypoint extraction via PersonLab/PoseNet, 25% missingness handled by ROI center padding, score-based weighting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Pose occlusion (>25% missing) causes descriptor collapse to uniform ROI.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Posterior probability calibration for uncertain keypoint associations. GSE: Temporal tracking of player intent via confidence-weighted trajectory.
layer2.telemetry: Frame-level keypoint count and average confidence as anomaly indicators

primitives.name: Bilinear Fusion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Pairwise bilinear fusion (y = x_1^T A x_2 + b) of the three branches, summed, softmax.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{ij}': 'Learned weight matrix (dimensionless)', 'b': 'Bias term (logit scale)', 'softmax': 'Normalizes output to categorical distribution'}
primitives.assumptions: Feature independence within branch, shared linear bias, quadratic interaction captured by outer product.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Co-linearity between fused streams leads to singular covariance, preventing inversion.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Dempster-Shafer evidence combination for multi-source uncertainty. GSE: State-action value function integration across sensor modalities.
layer2.telemetry: Fusion matrix rank and eigenvalue spectrum as convergence diagnostics

primitives.name: Attention Blocks
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Method Three parallel branches: RGB and OF streams through 3D spatio-temporal convolutions (3 layers: 30/60/80 filters of 3×3×3, max-pool 2×2×2, attention blocks, FC-500); the pose stream through 1D temporal convolutions over the N_joints×3 descriptor channels with temporal max-pooling.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W_H, W_S': 'Weight matrices (learned)', 'σ': 'Sigmoid activation (dimensionless)', 'H': 'High-level feature map', 'S': 'Source feature map'}
primitives.assumptions: Spatial attention via sigmoid gating, learned linear projections, independent across branches.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Vanishing gradients in deep networks cause ineffective attention.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Adaptive Kalman filtering for time-varying observation noise. GSE: Contextual bandit action selection with posterior sampling.
layer2.telemetry: Attention map sparsity and channel-wise variance as network health metrics

primitives.name: Joint Detection-Segmentation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Target: stroke class (classification task) or per-frame class labels via sliding-window decision fusion (vote/average/Gaussian-weighted, window 150/150/201).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f(w)': 'Window weight function (vote, average, Gaussian)', 'W_t': 'Sliding window centered at frame t', 'I': 'Indicator function (binary)'}
primitives.assumptions: Temporal consistency enforced via majority voting, Gaussian smoothing captures local motion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Short windows miss long-range context, long windows blur event boundaries.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Online change-point detection via cumulative sum statistics. GSE: Trajectory prediction with interval constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Segmentation F1-score and boundary precision as performance metrics

Bilinear fusion captures second-order interactions between these modalities, enabling the model to learn complex conjunctions that pure classification cannot. Joint detection-segmentation then translates per-frame predictions into temporally coherent event hypotheses, bridging the gap between short-term action recognition and long-term game understanding. This modular design allows for incremental improvement: adding new modalities or refining individual streams directly impacts downstream performance.
